title_en: 2026 Drone and Urban Air Mobility Expo at KINTEX, Goyang, 4–6 November
summary: The 2026 Goyang Drone and Urban Air Mobility (UAM) Expo will be held from 4 to 6 November 2026 in Hall 2 of KINTEX Exhibition Center 1. Visitors may register in advance at https://www.droneuamexpo.kr, and admission is free with advance registration. The notice is for information only and does not state who should attend or that attendance is required.

dates.what: Conference: UAM future talent development open lecture (organised by the Korea Transportation Safety Authority)
Conference: global UAM market trends and domestic promotion measures, and the K-UAM International Conference
Conference: AI and drones, their application to aerospace and the future (hosted by the Ministry of Employment and Labor and others)

conditions: Admission is free if you register in advance on the expo website.
The host organisations may limit the number of participants depending on their circumstances.
The detailed session timetable is given only in an attachment, which was not read for this translation.
steps: Read the attached detailed timetable and conference (seminar) file in the original notice; their content was not read for this translation.
Register in advance at https://www.droneuamexpo.kr to receive free admission.
Attend the expo in Hall 2, KINTEX Exhibition Center 1 (Goyang), between 4 and 6 November 2026.
translation:
Announcement: 2026 Drone and Urban Air Mobility Expo (KINTEX, Goyang, 4–6 November)

A. Event name: 2026 Goyang Drone and Urban Air Mobility Expo

B. Date and venue: Wednesday 4 November to Friday 6 November 2026 / Hall 2, KINTEX Exhibition Center 1

C. Visitor registration: https://www.droneuamexpo.kr / free with advance registration

D. Main programme: exhibition, conferences (12 sessions), side events, opening ceremony, etc.

Category | Schedule | Main content | Notes

Exhibition | 4 (Wed) – 6 (Fri) November | (Drones) general medium and large unmanned aircraft, communication aircraft, etc.; (UAM) MRO, satellite antennas, vertiports, etc.; *(Participants) Korean Air, LI… [the list of participants is cut off in the original notice] | Hall 2, Exhibition Center 1

Hands-on events | Drone piloting, drone soccer, light aircraft ride experience, etc.

Conferences (12 sessions):
- 4 (Wed) November | Open lecture on developing future UAM talent | (Organised by) Korea Transportation Safety Authority
- 5 (Thu) November | Global UAM market trends and measures to promote the domestic market | Own event
- 5 (Thu) November | K-UAM INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE | Own event (international conference)
- 6 (Fri) November | AI and drones: application to aerospace and the future | (Hosted by) Ministry of Employment and Labor and others

* For the detailed timetable, refer to the attachment. (The number of participants may be limited depending on the circumstances of the host organisations.)
